Welcome to hearme 🎙️

Everything runs locally — your voice never leaves this Mac. Two macOS permissions are needed. During development they go to your terminal app; the bundled app prompts on its own.

Microphone
to hear you (prompted on first dictation)
Accessibility
for the keyboard shortcut and to type text — restart hearme once after granting
Globe (fn) key
set "Press 🌐 key to" → Do Nothing, so fn only dictates

Then try it: click into any text field, hold fn, speak, release. fn + space goes hands-free (press fn to stop). fn + shift dictates and polishes. Change any of them in Settings → General; Settings → Status shows what's missing.
